title.headline: 1,100 store leases. Every break clause found.

end.line: Quillon for Castlegate Retail’s property legal team

vo: Castlegate Retail's property team manages eleven hundred store leases, with every break clause tracked in a spreadsheet.
Vault reads all eleven hundred leases at once, and every break date and notice period lands in one table.
Ask which leases can exit next year, and Quillon reads across the whole portfolio before it answers.
When finance emails the same question, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to each lease clause.
Grace will walk your team through it on Wednesday the eighteenth.
